def move(terrain, start, duration_s, n_runs, seed):
    import numpy as np
    rng = np.random.default_rng(seed)

    # times: 60 time steps: 0s, 1s, ..., 59s (fixed 60 points)
    times = np.linspace(0, duration_s, 60)
    dt = np.diff(times, prepend=0)

    # Initialize points array: (n_runs, 60, 3): lat, lon, seconds
    points = np.empty((n_runs, 60, 3), dtype=float)

    # Set initial lat/lon: start is (lat, lon)
    points[:, 0, 0] = start[0]
    points[:, 0, 1] = start[1]
    points[:, 0, 2] = 0

    # Direction: due south = bearing 180 degrees = pi rad
    bearing_rad = np.pi

    # Precompute constants
    m_lat = terrain.m_lat
    m_lon = terrain.m_lon

    # Current positions (lat, lon)
    lat = np.full(n_runs, start[0])
    lon = np.full(n_runs, start[1])

    # Initialize ok mask (inside terrain)
    ok = terrain.inside(lat, lon)

    # Each step 1 sec (approximate duration of step)
    for i in range(1, 60):
        if not np.any(ok):
            # All walkers have left terrain, stop simulation early
            points[ok == False, i:, 0] = lat[ok == False, np.newaxis]
            points[ok == False, i:, 1] = lon[ok == False, np.newaxis]
            points[ok == False, i:, 2] = times[i]
            break

        # For active walkers only
        active = ok.copy()

        # Current positions
        lat_active = lat[active]
        lon_active = lon[active]

        # At each location:
        # Get slope_deg at current position
        slope = terrain.slope_deg(lat_active, lon_active)

        # Compute Tobler speed considering slope:
        # Need elevation difference for tobler_speed_ms(d_elev_m, d_horiz_m)
        # Approximate: step size horizontal = 1m here (small step), to get d_elev_m:
        # Instead of offsetting and measuring elevation difference, approximate elevation difference as slope * step distance
        # slope_deg to radians:
        slope_rad = np.deg2rad(slope)
        d_horiz_m = 1.0
        d_elev_m = d_horiz_m * np.tan(slope_rad)

        # Walking speed m/s with Tobler's function at this slope
        speed = terrain.tobler_speed_ms(d_elev_m, d_horiz_m)  # shape (active count,)

        # For duration dt[i], move: dist = speed * dt = speed * (times[i] - times[i-1])
        dist = speed * dt[i]

        # Move due south by dist (bearing pi)
        lat_new, lon_new = terrain.offset(lat_active, lon_active, bearing_rad, dist)

        # Clamp to terrain box in case outside?
        lat_new, lon_new = terrain.clamp(lat_new, lon_new)

        # Update global arrays
        lat[active] = lat_new
        lon[active] = lon_new

        # Update ok mask
        ok = terrain.inside(lat, lon)

        # Record positions and times
        points[active, i, 0] = lat_new
        points[active, i, 1] = lon_new
        points[active, i, 2] = times[i]

        # For inactive already left, fill positions and time with last known
        inactive = ~active
        points[inactive, i, 0] = points[inactive, i-1, 0]
        points[inactive, i, 1] = points[inactive, i-1, 1]
        points[inactive, i, 2] = times[i]

    # For any remaining timestamps if loop ended early, fill last position and time
    for i in range(points.shape[1]):
        mask = np.isnan(points[:, i, 2])
        if not np.any(mask):
            break
        points[mask, i, 0] = points[mask, i-1, 0]
        points[mask, i, 1] = points[mask, i-1, 1]
        points[mask, i, 2] = times[i]

    return points, ok
